verdict.rationale: Exa documents a Free Tier with $10 in credits on sign-up (up to 2,500 Lite searches) that resets monthly, with no payment method required. A community user confirms signing up for a trial account and successfully prototyping a chatbot integration with the search API. Missing for 10: consistent figures across pages (the sign-up amount is quoted as $10, $10 plus a $10 bonus, or $20), and documentation of free-tier-specific rate limits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype against the API on a free tier or free credits

citations.quote: The Free Tier gives you $10 in credits (up to 2,500 Lite searches) the day you sign up, and your free balance resets to $10 on the first of every month. No payment method required.
$20 credits on sign-up with $10 credits every month. No payment method required
A user signed up for a trial account and was 'pretty impressed with the search API'.
